column1: # Stations of the nav gauntlet, generated by scripts/gauntlet/gen_gauntlet.py.
# `plans` is what the PLANNER does today - measured, not predicted: does A* reach
# the goal at all. It is a regression lock. A change here is a change in what an
# agent will even ATTEMPT, and should always be a deliberate one.
# `expect` is what a vanilla player could do with MOVEMENT ALONE - no opening
# doors, no building. It is design intent, not a measurement, and nothing
# asserts against it; the report scores `plans` against it to say which
# refusals are correct and which are gaps.
